name: balatro-web

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:sdk && node scripts/copy-sdk-to-site.mjs
scripts.build:sdk: vite build --config vite.sdk.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.sdk.json && node scripts/package-sdk.mjs
scripts.pack:sdk: npm run build:sdk && npm pack ./dist-sdk --pack-destination artifacts
scripts.test: npm run test:game && npm run test:rules
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:game:browser && npm run test:sdk:browser && npm run test:sdk:host && npm run test:sdk:package

description: All-unlocked Balatro-inspired Web gameplay recreation with an embeddable SDK and injected strategies
